note: Source of the physmat quantity registry. unit_tables.json is generated from this file: python -m physmat.units --write. Rules: docs/packages/physmat/units.md.

dB.name: decibel (10 log10 of a power ratio)

Mpsi.reading: megapound-force per square inch, about 6.895 GPa (founder decision 2026-11-09: imperial in, mil, psi, ksi only); write GPa or 1000 ksi

degF.reading: degree Fahrenheit: T/K = (t/degF + 459.67) x 5/9; write K or degC

R.reading: degree Rankine: 1 R = 5/9 K; write K

degK.reading: kelvin written with a degree sign; write K

Np.reading: neper, a field-amplitude unit: 1 Np = 20/ln(10) dB, about 8.686 dB of power

Np/m.reading: neper per metre, a field-amplitude unit: 1 Np/m is about 8.686 dB/m of power

ppb.reading: part per billion, 1e-9; write the number as a fraction

E-KEY-UNKNOWN.ko: 알 수 없는 키 또는 물리량 이름.

E-KEY-DUPLICATE.en: Duplicate key in one JSON object.
E-KEY-DUPLICATE.ko: 한 JSON 객체 안의 중복 키.

E-ID-CLASH.en: Two identifiers clash in one namespace.

E-UNIT-MISSING.en: A dimensional number has no unit.

E-UNIT-UNKNOWN.en: The text is not a recognised quantity string or unit spelling.
E-UNIT-UNKNOWN.ko: 인식할 수 없는 물리량 문자열 또는 단위 표기.

E-UNIT-AMBIGUOUS.en: The unit spelling has more than one reading.
E-UNIT-AMBIGUOUS.ko: 단위 표기를 두 가지 이상으로 읽을 수 있음.

E-UNIT-DIMENSION.en: The unit has another dimension than the quantity.

E-UNIT-NOT-ACCEPTED.en: The unit is not on the quantity's menu.
E-UNIT-NOT-ACCEPTED.ko: 물리량이 받는 단위 목록에 없는 단위.

E-DEGC-NOT-ABSOLUTE.en: degC used for a temperature difference or inside a compound unit.
E-DEGC-NOT-ABSOLUTE.ko: degC를 온도차나 복합 단위 안에 씀.

E-DOMAIN.en: The value is outside the quantity's hard domain or the range of a double.
E-DOMAIN.ko: 값이 물리량의 허용 범위나 double 범위를 벗어남.

E-GAIN.en: A passive material value means gain under exp(-i omega t).
E-GAIN.ko: 수동 재료 값이 exp(-i omega t)에서 이득을 뜻함.

E-BASIS.en: A total or per-depth value does not match the component's basis.
E-BASIS.ko: 합 또는 깊이당 값이 구성 요소의 기준과 맞지 않음.

E-CONTAINMENT.en: A feature lies outside its domain.

E-MESH-ESTIMATE.en: The estimated element count exceeds the limit.

E-SCALE-MISMATCH.en: A mesh file's extent disagrees with expected_extent.
E-SCALE-MISMATCH.ko: 메시 파일 크기가 expected_extent와 맞지 않음.

E-EXPRESSION-KIND.en: An expression of the wrong kind in a slot.

E-ABSOLUTE-AS-LOAD.en: An absolute pressure used as a mechanical load.

E-OVERDETERMINED.en: Two forms of one behaviour are given.

E-ORIENTATION-MISSING.en: An anisotropic property is used without material axes.
E-ORIENTATION-MISSING.ko: 재료 축 없이 이방성 물성을 씀.

E-ORIENTATION-INVALID.en: Material axes are zero or not orthogonal.

E-OUTSIDE-VALID.en: A property is evaluated outside its validity range.

E-DATUM-MISSING.en: A required datum (reference condition) is missing.

E-PROPERTY-MISSING.en: A physics needs a property the material does not give.

E-STATE-MISSING.en: A required state variable is missing.

E-COUPLING-PAIR.en: A coupling pair is not in the registry's coupling table.
E-COUPLING-PAIR.ko: 등록부의 결합 표에 없는 결합 쌍.

E-COUPLING-CYCLE.en: Couplings form a cycle without an iteration.

E-TEMPERATURE-NONPOSITIVE.en: A solved temperature is at or below 0 K.

W-MAGNITUDE.en: The value is outside the quantity's plausibility band.

W-DEPTH-RATIO.en: Depth over in-plane size is outside the usual range.
W-DEPTH-RATIO.ko: 깊이와 면내 크기의 비가 흔한 범위를 벗어남.

W-TIME-SCALE.en: The time scale of a transient looks wrong.
W-TIME-SCALE.ko: 과도 해석의 시간 축척이 이상해 보임.

W-CAVITY-SCALE.en: The cavity size and frequency do not fit.

W-PM-ROUNDING.en: A geometry value moved by 1e-3 pm or more onto the pm grid.
W-PM-ROUNDING.ko: 형상 값이 pm 격자로 1e-3 pm 이상 옮겨짐.

W-WIEDEMANN-FRANZ.en: Thermal and electrical conductivity disagree with the Wiedemann-Franz law.
W-WIEDEMANN-FRANZ.ko: 열·전기 전도도가 비데만-프란츠 법칙과 맞지 않음.

W-SOUND-SPEED.en: sqrt(E/rho) is outside the range of solids.

W-CELSIUS-AS-KELVIN.en: A temperature written in K looks like a Celsius value.
W-CELSIUS-AS-KELVIN.ko: K로 쓴 온도가 섭씨 값처럼 보임.

W-DATUM-FAR.en: A constant is evaluated far from its datum temperature.
W-DATUM-FAR.ko: 상수를 기준 온도에서 멀리 떨어진 곳에서 씀.

W-LIBRARY-RATIO.en: An override differs strongly from its library base, or looks swapped.
W-LIBRARY-RATIO.ko: 재정의 값이 라이브러리 기준과 크게 다르거나 뒤바뀐 듯함.

W-GAUGE-ATMOSPHERIC.en: A gauge pressure is close to atmospheric pressure.

W-STRAIN-LARGE.en: Strain or displacement is large for linear elasticity.
W-STRAIN-LARGE.ko: 선형 탄성에 비해 변형률이나 변위가 큼.

W-TEMPERATURE-RANGE.en: Solved temperatures are outside the expected range.

W-EFFECTIVE-INDEX-RANGE.en: An effective index is outside the indices of the solved regions.
W-EFFECTIVE-INDEX-RANGE.ko: 유효 굴절률이 풀이 영역의 굴절률 범위를 벗어남.

I-PM-ROUNDING.en: A geometry value moved by less than 1e-3 pm onto the pm grid.
I-PM-ROUNDING.ko: 형상 값이 pm 격자로 1e-3 pm 미만 옮겨짐.

I-VERTEX-SNAPPED.en: A mesher dropped or merged an input vertex.

I-DEFAULT-BOUNDARY.en: An omitted boundary gets the physics' natural condition.
I-DEFAULT-BOUNDARY.ko: 생략된 경계에 물리의 자연 조건을 씀.

I-UNUSED-PROPERTY.en: A material property that no physics in the run reads.
I-UNUSED-PROPERTY.ko: 실행의 어떤 물리도 읽지 않는 재료 물성.

I-EXTRAPOLATED.en: A property is evaluated outside its valid range on request.
I-EXTRAPOLATED.ko: 요청에 따라 유효 범위 밖에서 물성을 계산함.

I-ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE.en: A library value of order-of-magnitude quality is used.
I-ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE.ko: 자릿수 수준 품질의 라이브러리 값을 씀.

I-OVERDETERMINED-CONSISTENT.en: Two consistent forms of one behaviour are given.
I-OVERDETERMINED-CONSISTENT.ko: 한 거동의 일치하는 두 형태를 줌.

I-CONSTANT-UNDER-COUPLING.en: A constant property is used under a coupling.
